items.title: Press Briefing by the Spokesperson on Bhote Koshi Flood
items.summary: Teams have recovered 903 bodies from the flood areas and rescued over 10,000 people, including 323 foreign nationals. About 4,200 people remain unaccounted for, with 590 foreigners from 39 countries still missing.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Press Briefing by the Spokesperson on Bhote Koshi Flood

items.title: Nepal Police — DNA profiling for unidentified remains
items.summary: Families of people missing in the Rasuwa floods can now help identify recovered bodies through DNA testing. Relatives in Nepal can give a blood sample at the Nepal Police Hospital or a district police office.
items.citation: Nepal Police HQ — Information on DNA Profiling for unidentified Dead Bodies (31 Aug)

items.source: National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA)
items.title: NDRRMA — Bhotekoshi water level rising again (31 Aug)
items.summary: Water levels in the Bhotekoshi River have risen again. People in Rasuwa, Nuwakot, Dhading, Chitwan and nearby areas should stay cautious.
items.citation: NDRRMA Nepal — public warning via official channels

items.title: Press Briefing Note by Foreign Secretary on Bhote Koshi Flood (Sunday, 2:00 PM, 30 August 2026)
items.summary: Rescue teams have recovered 734 bodies and saved over 8,000 people, including more than 260 foreigners. Nearly 2,500 remain missing, with over 400 of them from other countries, as searches keep going in the affected districts.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Press Briefing Note by Foreign Secretary on Bhote Koshi Flood (Sunday, 2:00 PM, 30 August 2026)

items.title: Press Briefing Note by Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs on Bhote Koshi Flood
items.summary: Flash floods struck the Bhote Koshi River on August 26, and teams have recovered 626 bodies while about 2400 people remain unaccounted for. Over 4450 people have been rescued so far, including more than 187 foreign nationals, with teams still working in the affected districts.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Press Briefing Note by Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs on Bhote Koshi Flood

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 28 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods hit Nepal's Bhote Koshi River on 26 August, killing many people and damaging homes, roads, bridges and other infrastructure. Rescue teams have recovered 538 bodies so far, with hundreds of locals and tourists still missing.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 28 August 2026

items.title: FOCUS | Rescue operations at mudslide-hit border port in SW China's Xizang
items.summary: Rescue crews and helicopters are working at the mudslide site around Gyirong Port. Three people have been killed and 558 remain missing.
items.citation: Xinhua (Gyirong / Tibet side) — FOCUS | Rescue operations at mudslide-hit border port in SW China's Xizang

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods-27 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods hit Nepal’s Bhote Koshi River on 26 August, destroying homes, roads and bridges and leaving many people missing. So far 359 bodies have been recovered and 596 others from 33 countries remain unaccounted for.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Latest Updates on Flash Floods-27 August 2026

items.title: NOTICE: Emergency Control Room (ECR) for Assistance regarding Foreign Nationals Affected by the Bhote Koshi Flash Flood
items.summary: Nepal has opened an emergency room to help with foreign nationals who are missing or affected by the flash floods in Rasuwa. Families can reach them on +977-9744441227 or +977-9744441228 from 7am to 10pm.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — NOTICE: Emergency Control Room (ECR) for Assistance regarding Foreign Nationals Affected by the Bhote Koshi Flash Flood

items.title: Special Control Room in MEA for Nepal Floods Situation
items.summary: India's foreign ministry has opened a round-the-clock control room in Delhi for the Nepal floods. Families can call +91 11 2308 8718 or +91 11 2308 8719, or message +91 9968291988 on WhatsApp.
items.citation: MEA press release — Special Control Room in MEA for Nepal Floods Situation

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 26 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods hit Nepal’s Bhote Koshi River this morning, washing out homes, roads and bridges and leaving many people missing. Rescue teams have recovered 72 bodies so far, with 403 others reported missing.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 26 August 2026
